purpose: Independent cross-check of PCB fabrication option adders (second source to the Chinese fabs' per-m2 price lists). Fab's own statements first; secondary sources recorded separately and labelled.

kinds.fab price list / help page: the fab's own published statement of a price, surcharge, free option or relative price (help centre, price notice, fab's own cost webinar / design guide)
kinds.secondary: blogs, guides, forum posts, a fab's generic educational blog that does not state that fab's own price, third-party summaries

options.option: 1. Board thickness other than 1.6 mm (0.8 / 1.0 / 2.0 / 2.4 / 3.2 mm)

findings.unit: price indicator relative to 1.60 mm (1.00 = 100%), whole board price
findings.conditions: 4-layer multilayer, Tg150, 35 um copper; stackups ML4_TG150_0.50_35 (1x0.10 core + 4x1080), ML4_TG150_1.00_35 (1x0.41 core + 4x2116), ML4_TG150_1.60_35 (1x0.71 core + 4x7628), ML4_TG150_3.20_35 (1x2.40 core + 4x7628). Volume / board size not stated. German fab (Wuerth Elektronik CBT). Same slide repeated unchanged in the 05.04.2023 German webinar (slide 17). 2.0 / 2.4 / 0.8 mm named as 'further standards' but not priced.
findings.quote: Comparison of a 4-layer multilayer with different thicknesses ... Standard: 1,55 mm / 1,60 mm  Optimum: 1,00 mm  Further standards: 0,80mm / 2,00 mm / 2,40 mm ... Price indicator 107% [0.50] Price indicator 96% [1.00] Price indicator 100% [1.60] Price indicator 137% [3.20]
findings.dateOfSource: webinar 14.07.2020 (PDF modified 23.03.2022); German version webinar 05.04.2023 slide 17 identical figures (https://www.we-online.com/files/pdf1/webinar-91-wie-beeinflusst-ihr-leiterplattenlayout-die-kosten-in-der-leiterplattenfertigung-cbt-de.pdf)

findings.unit: price indicator relative to the standard 6-layer 1.60 mm stackup
findings.conditions: 6-layer 1.60 mm: standard (2x0.36 core, 6x2116) = 100%; specific stackup with thin cores (2x0.10 core, 2x2116 + 8x7628) = 116%; core-based (3x0.20 core) = 122%. Not a thickness change but shows the stackup (prepreg / core count) effect that a non-standard thickness triggers.
findings.quote: Comparison of a 6-layer multilayer: 1,60 mm standard vs. individual stackup ... Price indicator 100% ... Price indicator 116% ... Additional costs: Handling thin laminate, 4 prepregs more in stackup ... Core-based stackup ... Price indicator 122%

findings.conditions: Seeed Fusion standard PCB (2-layer prototype service); old capabilities page (copyright 2008-2016). The current Seeed wiki (updated 16 Sep 2026) no longer states this and shows no option prices.
findings.quote: The costs of 0.8mm, 1.0mm, 1.2mm, and 1.6mm are same

findings.value: extra cost for special thickness; amounts only in a chart image
findings.conditions: JLCPCB help centre 'In what cases will there be charged extra' (last updated 10 Nov 2026). The thickness surcharge table is an image; the text gives no figure. The quote page shows a price only after interaction.
findings.quote: (thickness surcharge given in a chart image only - not readable as text)

findings.value: 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.6 mm free on 2- and 4-layer with standard options
findings.conditions: Blog author's reading of the JLCPCB quote page; 'most of these are only free of extra charge when choosing green silkscreen ... and no other special options'. No amount for 2.0 mm etc.
findings.quote: 2-layer and 4-layer PCBs with standard options ... 0.8mm, 1.0mm, 1.2mm, 1.6mm ... most of these are only free of extra charge when choosing green silkscreen and (and no other special options)

options.notFound: No fab states an absolute add-on ($ / order, $ / m2, EUR / dm2) for 2.0 / 2.4 / 3.2 mm. Eurocircuits: thickness only described as pooled (1.00 / 1.55 / 2.40 mm in STANDARD pool) vs non-pooled with no figure; Beta LAYOUT, Multi-CB, PCBWay, NextPCB, ALLPCB, Elecrow list thicknesses without prices (price only after the online calculator is run - not read). JLCPCB's figure is in a chart image. ALLPCB's site shows a notice that it is temporarily suspending operations.

options.option: 2. High-Tg laminate (Tg150 / Tg170, S1000-2, IT-180A) v standard FR-4 Tg130-140; high-CTI (>= 600) laminate

findings.unit: fraction of board price (+23%), Tg135 -> Tg150
findings.conditions: Example comparison 1.6 mm / 6-layer multilayer. Wuerth base-material recommendation: standard FR4 Tg135 up to 3 lead-free solder processes; Tg150 for higher Cu, filled buried vias, > 3 solder processes; Tg170 halogen-free for high layer counts. No Tg170 figure.
findings.quote: Example comparison: 1,6mm / 6 layers  Multilayer price increase  Tg135 to Tg150: 23%

findings.unit: increase in PCBWay's production cost (absorbed - not charged to the customer)
findings.conditions: PCBWay switched 4-layer-and-above boards from Kingboard to Shengyi laminate and says it gives this upgrade free. PCBWay default material Tg 150-160 C. This is a laminate-brand change at mid-Tg, not a priced Tg130 -> Tg170 adder.
findings.quote: The default material of PCBWay has a TG of 150-160℃ ... despite a 10%-30% increase in production costs ... this upgrade will be provided to customers free of charge.

findings.value: Tg150 / Tg170 (S1000-2, S1000-2M) and High-CTI >= 600 V (Shengyi S1600) are selectable; price shown only after 'Calculate'
findings.conditions: PCBWay advanced (high quality) order form. Total reads $0.00 until Calculate is clicked; some materials not stocked (7-20 day purchase). Not read.
findings.quote: To ensure quality, we will not stock these materials generally. 7-20 days purchase period

findings.conditions: JLCPCB 6-layer page lists material 'Tg 135-140 / Tg 155' with no price. JLCPCB CTI blog says JLCPCB carries 'high CTI materials' but states no price and does not say >= 600 V.
Generic guide on JLCPCB's blog, not a JLCPCB price; FAQ: 'Typically 30-60% higher than standard FR-4'. Basis not stated.
findings.quote: Cost Index | 1.0 | 1.3–1.6 | 1.8–2.5 ... Typically 30–60% higher than standard FR-4

findings.unit: relative cost factor; also 'manufacturing cost impact ... 15-25% higher'
findings.conditions: OurPCB blog (a Chinese fab's generic guide, not its price list); basis (volume, size) not stated.
findings.quote: Relative Cost Factor | 1.0x | 1.2-1.4x | 1.4-1.6x ... The manufacturing cost impact for high-Tg materials is typically 15-25% higher than standard FR-4

findings.unit: raw-material price increase relative to Tg150 material
findings.conditions: Wuerth impedance webinar, slide 'Impact of new Materials' - refers to high-speed / low-loss materials (Dk 3.6, Df 0.004 class), NOT to high-Tg FR-4. Recorded only so it is not mistaken for a high-Tg figure.
findings.quote: Raw Material ... Price increase 4x - 20x to Tg150 Material

options.notFound: High-CTI (>= 600): NO fab price or relative price found anywhere (PCBWay lists S1600 CTI>=600 but prices only after Calculate; JLCPCB says it carries high-CTI material without a figure). Tg170 / S1000-2 / IT-180A: no fab's own priced adder found (only Wuerth Tg135->150 +23%, and PCBWay's absorbed 10-30% Kingboard->Shengyi cost). Eurocircuits, Beta LAYOUT (lists Tg135 / Tg170), Multi-CB (lists Tg135 / HTg150 / HTg170), NextPCB (TG130-TG170 listed) give no figure.

options.option: 3. Via fill: resin-filled, via-in-pad plated over (POFV), solder-mask plugged / tented

findings.conditions: Epoxy filled & capped (POFV) via-in-pad on 6-20 layer boards, international market, sample and batch. 4-layer POFV still charged (amount not stated).
findings.quote: For international market, JLCPCB via-in-pad on 6- 20 layer PCBs are upgraded to POFV (Plated Over Filled Via) for free ... its costs will no longer be added to the total price whether it's a sample or batch order ... (POFV for 4-layer PCBs still requires charges.)

findings.conditions: Resin filling on 6-layer and above; help article last updated 10 Nov 2026. Same article: epoxy-filled vias 'Complex process, high cost' (no figure).
findings.quote: For our 6-layer and above multi-layer boards, resin filling is now available for free

findings.conditions: Price notice during resin-plugging line expansion: 4-layer boards with resin-filled vias; 6+ layer only lead time +~5 days; ~15 day adjustment period.
findings.quote: 4-Layer PCBs with Resin Filled Vias: Prices will experience a slight increase.

findings.unit: Wuerth 'Kostenindikator' - number of EUR coin symbols (ordinal, not a price)
findings.conditions: Design guide Plugging - Filling - Tenting, Version 1 / Dezember 2019. Type VII (resin filled + copper capped) is the only one for via-in-pad. Plugged made in Germany; filled-and-covered made in China.
findings.quote: Kostenindikator: Plugged Via IPC-4761 Type III-a € | Filled Via Type V €€ | Filled & Covered Via Type VI-a € | Filled & Capped Via Type VII €€€ (read from the rendered table, page 4)

findings.conditions: Eurocircuits: resin via filling selectable in Advanced options (soldermask filling discontinued July 2020); plugging not offered; no price stated. PCBWay: tenting / plugged with solder mask / not covered on standard form; resin plugging and via-in-pad under advanced options 'We may add extra cost for these special options which will be confirmed after review' (not read).
findings.quote: In our manufacturing processes we only use Filling as it has considerably more advantages than Plugging.

findings.unit: % of overall PCB manufacturing cost (via filling for via-in-pad)
findings.conditions: ALLPCB generic blog (not its price list).
findings.quote: via filling can add anywhere from 10% to 30% to the overall manufacturing cost of a PCB with via-in-pad designs (as returned by search summary; page not opened)

options.notFound: No fab states a $ / order, $ / m2 or % adder for resin fill / POFV on 4-layer, nor for solder-mask plugging v tenting (both free / default at JLCPCB and PCBWay standard forms, no figure). Seeed, NextPCB, Multi-CB, Beta LAYOUT: nothing priced. Wuerth gives only an ordinal cost indicator.

options.option: 4. ENIG gold thickness 2 u" or 3 u" v 1 u"

findings.unit: $ per m2 for every 1% of ENIG area above 30% of the board (top + bottom = 200%)
findings.conditions: JLCPCB ENIG area surcharge. 2U is exactly 2.0x the 1U rate per excess-area point (1.7985 / 0.8992 = 2.000, arithmetic). Charge applies only to the gold area above 30%; the base ENIG option price is in the quote tool (not read).
findings.quote: For 1U'' gold thickness, $0.8992/m² will be charged for every 1% for the portion exceeding 30%. ... For 2U'' gold thickness, $1.7985/m² will be charged for every 1% for the portion exceeding 30%.

findings.value: 2U default / no extra cost on 6+ layers
findings.conditions: JLCPCB 6-20 layer boards: 2u" gold is the default at no extra cost (blog 'Free Upgrade to ENIG 2u"', Feb 2024 per search summary; direct page returned 404 on 2026-11-25). JLCPCB 6-layer page lists only 'ENIG 2u"'. A later JLCPCB OSP notice says ENIG is no longer a free finish (layer scope / date not confirmed - page 404).
findings.quote: ENIG 2u"

findings.unit: Kostenfaktor (cost factor) of the surface finish, HAL lead-free = 1.00
findings.conditions: Wuerth webinar 05.04.2023 slide 14 'Vergleich der verschiedenen Endoberflaechen'. ENIG at Au 0.075 um (~3 u"). Finish-only factor, NOT a whole-board % and NOT a 1u v 2u v 3u comparison. Electroplated gold (Au 1-3 um) 'Preisindikator: bis zu 500% oder mehr (je nach aktuellem Goldpreis)'.
findings.quote: Vergleich der verschiedenen Endoberflaechen ... Kostenfaktor 1,34 [HAL] 1,00 [HAL LF] 1,18 [Chem. Sn 0,8um] 1,33 [Chem. Sn 1um] 1,44 [Chem. Ag] 2,50 [Chem. Ni/Au: Ni 5,5um Au 0,075um]

findings.conditions: Seeed Fusion standard PCB, old service page ((c) 2008-2016): 'HASL (Lead Free) +$5, ENIG+$10'. Gold thickness not stated. Out of date.
findings.quote: HASL, HASL (Lead Free) +$5, ENIG+$10.

findings.value: gold extra cost depends on gold area
findings.conditions: PCBWay 'What PCBs will be charged of extra cost' (last updated 18/06/2024); PCBWay order page shows 1U" default, other thicknesses priced after review / Calculate (not read).
findings.quote: the extra cost depends on gold area, the larger area the higher cost.

findings.unit: % of bare board cost (ENIG v baseline finish)
findings.conditions: JLCPCB generic blog on hard gold; ENIG premium, no thickness split; no basis stated.
findings.quote: ENIG typically adds 5-15% to the bare board cost,

options.notFound: No fab states a whole-board $ or % for 2u" or 3u" v 1u" ENIG. The only fab figure that separates thickness is JLCPCB's excess-area surcharge (2U = 2x 1U per point of area above 30%). 3u" not priced anywhere (Wuerth's ENIG factor is at Au 0.075 um ~3u" but against HAL LF, not against 1u"). Eurocircuits, Multi-CB, Beta LAYOUT, NextPCB, ALLPCB, Elecrow: nothing.

findings.value: standard impedance testing free (+/-20%); precision impedance testing chargeable (amount not stated)
findings.conditions: JLCPCB multilayer standard laminated structures help article (last updated 16 Nov 2026).

findings.conditions: NextPCB, 4-layer: three standard stack-ups at no extra cost; any deviation >= $80. Separate page: 40+ standard stack-ups at no additional cost, tolerance > 50 ohm +/-10%, <= 50 ohm +/-5%.

options.notFound: No fab publishes a $ fee for impedance control itself or for +/-5% v +/-10% (JLCPCB: 'chargeable' / 'special request' with no amount; NextPCB: free on standard stackups, >= $80 non-standard stackup; PCBWay: 'We may add extra cost ... confirmed after review'; Seeed: only 'impedance control may be required', 2 oz not combinable). Eurocircuits / Wuerth / Beta LAYOUT: no figure.

findings.conditions: JLCPCB: inner layer 0.5 oz default, 1 oz, 2 oz; 'Availability depends on total layers and overall thickness'; 'Always refer to the actual online order page for current availability and pricing.' 2 oz inner only on 4-layer 1.6 mm with a named stackup and 2 oz outer (help centre).
findings.quote: 0.5oz (default), 1oz, 2oz ... Always refer to the actual online order page for current availability and pricing.

findings.value: laminate purchase price rises with copper cladding (bar chart, approximate)
findings.unit: % of the 35/35 um laminate purchase price (2020 = 100%) - MATERIAL price, not board price
findings.conditions: Wuerth webinar 05.04.2023 slide 13 'Vergleich Materialpreise Einkauf FR4 (Stand 09.07.2020 / Stand 03.04.2023)'. Bars read off the chart, about +/-5 points: 1.55 mm 35/35 um 100% (2020) / ~147% (2023); 70/70 um ~140% / ~205%; 105/105 um ~210% / ~327%. 0.51 mm cores: 70/70 ~152% / ~202%. Applies to clad laminate (cores), i.e. the inner-layer copper weight. Chart-read values, not printed numbers.
findings.quote: Vergleich Materialpreise Einkauf FR4 (Stand 09.07.2020 / Stand 03.04.2023) ... Vergleich pro Material immer mit 35 µm Kupferkaschierung als 100%-Basis ... Kupfer spielt also eine wichtige Rolle im Leiterplattenpreis!

findings.value: 2 oz cannot be combined with impedance control
findings.conditions: Seeed Fusion pricing update (via search summary); no price for inner copper.
findings.quote: 2oz copper weight cannot be combined with impedance control.

options.notFound: No fab states a $ / % / per-m2 adder for 1 oz or 2 oz inner copper (JLCPCB, PCBWay, NextPCB, Elecrow, Eurocircuits, Beta LAYOUT list the options; prices only in the calculators - not read). Wuerth's chart is laminate PURCHASE price, not board price.

notes: Fab-published add-on PRICES are rare: the Chinese prototype fabs (JLCPCB, PCBWay, NextPCB, Elecrow, ALLPCB) and the European pools (Eurocircuits, Beta LAYOUT, Multi-CB, WEdirekt) show option prices only inside their JavaScript calculators after interaction; those were NOT read or estimated. The fab's own quantitative statements found: (a) Wuerth Elektronik CBT cost webinars (14.07.2020 EN; 05.04.2023 DE) - thickness 0.5/1.0/1.6/3.2 mm = 107/96/100/137% (4L Tg150), Tg135->Tg150 +23% (6L 1.6 mm), ENIG finish factor 2.50 v HAL-LF 1.00, plus an ordinal via-fill cost indicator in the Dec 2019 design guide (plugged EUR, filled EURx2, filled & covered EUR, filled & capped EURx3); (b) JLCPCB help centre (Nov 2026) - ENIG excess-area surcharge $0.8992 (1U) v $1.7985 (2U) per m2 per 1% over 30%; resin fill / POFV free on 6+ layers, charged on 4 layers (slight increase Aug 2026); standard impedance test free at +/-20%, precision chargeable, +/-5% on request; (c) NextPCB - impedance free on standard stackups, >= $80 for a non-standard stackup; (d) PCBWay - absorbed 10-30% cost for Kingboard->Shengyi on 4L+ (free to customer), everything else 'confirmed after review'. Wuerth figures are a German fab's relative prices (volume not stated) and are 3-6 years old; they cross-check DIRECTION and rough size, not Chinese per-m2 levels. Secondary (blog) figures are recorded but conflict widely and should not set a price. High-CTI >= 600 laminate: nothing found from any source. All dates of reading: 2026-11-25. WE PDFs were retrieved through WebFetch (direct curl blocked by Akamai 403) and read with pdftotext + page renders; Wuerth via-fill indicator and finish factors were read from the rendered slides.
